notes.title: Thank You for 5,000 Wishlists!
notes.content:
[p]Disc Creatures World has officially surpassed 5,000 wishlists![/p][p]Thank you so much to everyone who's been supporting us![/p][p]While the release date is still undecided, we're planning to launch a demo in the not-too-distant future.[/p][p]Thank you for your patience, and we hope you’re looking forward to it!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453458/cf88e980ab7f2a34f4391847e6ec93d4e10f524b.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Featured on IndieQuest2025!
notes.content:
On May 29th, Disc Creatures WORLD was featured in the JRPG showcase "IndieQuest2025", alongside many exciting titles from around the world!

Here’s the latest trailer that was shown during the showcase:
[previewyoutube=A31vc4NpNI0;full][/previewyoutube]  
This new trailer includes never-before-seen scenes and a new creature.  
You can also catch a glimpse of the "Shake System" and how it transforms your creatures—don’t miss it!

Watch the full IndieQuest2025 show here:
[previewyoutube=QAanpHTfrAw;full][/previewyoutube]
If you're a JRPG fan, this showcase is definitely worth checking out!

For the latest updates on Disc Creatures WORLD, be sure to follow us on X!
